status.idle: Test whether the current settings can access the network
status.running: Testing network access with the current settings...
status.success: Network connection succeeded via {route} in {elapsed_ms} ms
status.unexpected_end: The network test ended unexpectedly; try again
status.start_failed: Could not start the network test: {error}

failure.timeout: The network test timed out after {seconds} seconds
failure.send_request: Could not send the test request: {error}
failure.read_response: Could not read the test response: {error}
failure.invalid_http_status_line: The test site did not return a valid HTTP status line: {line}
failure.proxy_server: Could not reach the network through proxy {server}: {error}
failure.jump_task: Could not prepare the SSH jump host: {error}
failure.jump_resolve: Could not resolve SSH jump host {target}: {error}
failure.jump_connect: Could not connect to SSH jump host {target}: {error}

failure.direct: Could not connect directly to the test site: {error}

appearance.background_color_description: Overrides the terminal background supplied by the theme. This also changes the color reported to applications by OSC 11, which TUIs use to choose light or dark mode.
appearance.background_cover_title: Extend the background image beneath window controls?
appearance.background_cover_description: The image will extend beneath the title bar, window buttons, tabs, and SSH sidebar. Low-contrast images may make controls harder to see; the interface retains a minimum-opacity safeguard.

font.fallback_description: The first family is preferred; missing glyphs fall back through the remaining families, with bundled Maple as the final safe fallback.
font.group_description: The first family is primary; the rest are used in fallback order.

keymap.conflict: {combo} is assigned to both "{first}" and "{second}"; only the earlier "{first}" action will run.
keymap.help: Click a row to rebind · Backspace restores the default · Esc cancels

input.backup_secret: Credentials are stored only in the system credential manager

ssh.default_keys: If unspecified, IdentityFile and the default id_* private keys are used.
ssh.address_hint: Supports user@host; you can also paste ssh://host:2222
ssh.auth_auto_description: Tries available private keys first, then asks for a password. This is the best choice in most cases.
ssh.auth_interactive_description: Stores no credentials and prompts in the terminal when connecting, including two-factor authentication.
ssh.empty_hint: Use "+ Add host" or maintain aliases in ~/.ssh/config
ssh.shared_data_hint: Uses the same data as the legacy shell. Deleting a config alias hides it and it can be restored.

test.invalid_endpoint: The endpoint must start with http:// or https://
test.credential_read_failed: Could not read the API key from the credential manager
test.invalid_credential_encoding: The API key in the credential manager has invalid encoding
test.connection_failed: Could not connect to the server
test.auth_failed: Authentication failed (HTTP {status}); check the API key
test.endpoint_not_found: Endpoint not found (HTTP {status}); check the API endpoint
test.rate_limited: Service rate limited (HTTP {status}); it is reachable but quota cannot be verified now
test.start_failed: Could not start the provider test: {error}
